title: Conditions to check for Plans and Pricing

question.author: member_026
question.body: Could support clarify plans and pricing in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: Enterprise: custom storage and contract terms. Plan changes take effect at the start of the next billing cycle; upgrades apply immediately with prorated charges. CloudBox offers four plans. Free: 10 GB for individuals. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
